heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 94–455, title XIX, § 1901(a)(147), Oct. 4, 1976, 90 Stat. 1788]

notes.text: Section, added Aug. 12, 1955, ch. 870, § 3, 69 Stat. 717, related to computation of tax where taxpayer recovers substantial amount held by another under claim of right.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective for taxable years beginning after Dec. 31, 1976, see section 1901(d) of Pub. L. 94–455, set out as an Effective Date of 1976 Amendment note under section 2 of this title.
